notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

skipped.reason: Visible/invisible halves: reading principle without a chart condition.
'Fall into hell': not suitable for a report.

variants.text: The 12th lord with a benefic or in its own or exalted sign: money is spent on good causes.
The Moon rules the 12th and is dignified in the 5th, 9th or 11th: fine houses, beds and luxuries, riches, learning and a commanding air.
The 12th lord in the 6th or 8th: less happiness through the spouse, troubling expenses and little contentment.
The 12th lord in an angle or trine: full happiness through the spouse.

rules.text: A benefic in the 12th and an exalted 12th lord under benefic influence: spiritual liberation.
The 12th lord with malefics and malefics in and aspecting the 12th: wandering from country to country.
The 12th lord well placed with benefics in and aspecting the 12th: travel within one's own country.
Saturn or Mars in the 12th with no benefic aspect: earnings through questionable means.
The ascendant and 12th lords exchange houses, with Venus joining the 12th lord: money is spent on religious causes.
